item.title: Cercube for YouTube v6.1.3
item.description:
Cercube for YouTube 6.1.3 - the current official release (verified against apt.cercube.com on 2026-09-18).
This release improves caching, ad blocking, and compatibility with older iOS versions. - Added compatibility for iOS 15-16 - Minor bug fixes and improvements
Previously: 6.1.2 added dislike counts, sponsored segment skipping and 14 languages; 6.0.1 added compatibility for recent iOS versions.
